You and your partner compete in the way you both know best, having to wrestle with who controls the vessel – by ensuring that the only competition left is each other. If your next action is @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.gPUpPJbjkOHm9J6T]{Predation} , you can choose to either @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.PMbdMWc2QroouFGD]{Grapple}, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.ge56Lu1xXVFYUnLP]{Trip}, or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.7blmbDrQFNfdT731]{Shove} a creature before or after your Strike. You increase your multi-attack penalty only after you complete both actions. If the target belongs to a family in your selected Monster Affinity category, your maneuver attempt benefits from that feature’s circumstance bonus.

Special If you also have @UUID[Compendium.immortal-ardor.classes.YjTTl4kUZEvIWbdI]{Chimerian Tactics}, when you take this feat, Chimerian Tactics and Savage Predator become free actions when you perform the maneuver you selected for that feat.
